description: Dilution view of a listed Australian company: ASX announcements that signal new or changed share capital - applications for quotation of securities (Appendix 2A), proposed issues (Appendix 3B), placements, share purchase plans, entitlement offers, unquoted securities (options and performance rights), cessations and buy-backs - with counts per category and per month. Classified from the announcement headline; share counts and prices are inside the linked PDF and are not extracted. Source: ASX company announcements.
